servers.description: Enables AI assistants to query and explore Vertica databases through natural language with readonly protection by default. Supports SQL execution, schema discovery, large dataset streaming, and Vertica-specific optimizations like projection awareness.

VERTICA_READONLY_MODE.description: Enable readonly mode (only SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH queries allowed)

servers.name: Vertica MCP Server

servers.description: Enables storage and reuse of prompt templates with variable substitution for LLMs. Supports creating, searching, and retrieving prompt templates to avoid repeating complex instructions across conversations.

PROMPT_STORAGE_PATH.description: The absolute path where you want prompts stored

servers.name: Teleprompter

servers.description: Enables Claude Desktop and other MCP clients to interact with any OAuth2-authenticated OpenAPI-based API through automatic tool generation from OpenAPI specifications, with built-in token management and authentication handling.

API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the API (e.g., https://api.example.com)

OPENAPI_EXCLUDE.description: Optional comma-separated list of operations to exclude (e.g., deleteItem)

CUSTOM_TOOLS_PATH.description: Optional path to a custom tools JavaScript file

OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH.description: Path to the OpenAPI specification file (JSON format). Required for the server to function.

OPENAPI_TOOL_PREFIX.description: Optional prefix for generated tool names (e.g., api_)

OPENAPI_INCLUDE_ONLY.description: Optional comma-separated list of operations to include (e.g., listItems,createItem)

servers.name: MCP OpenAPI Connector

servers.description: Turns your Obsidian vault into an AI memory palace, enabling AI assistants to store knowledge with intent-based organization, retrieve information through full-text search, auto-link related notes, and query using Dataview syntax while maintaining provenance tracking.

PALACE_VAULTS.description: Vault configuration in format: path:alias:mode,... (e.g., /path/to/vault:main:rw or /path/to/work:work:rw,/path/to/personal:personal:rw)

PALACE_LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error

PALACE_DEFAULT_VAULT.description: Default vault alias (defaults to first vault if not specified)

servers.name: Obsidian Palace MCP

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to index and search codebases using semantic search powered by multiple embedding providers (OpenAI, VoyageAI, Gemini, Ollama) and vector database storage.

OLLAMA_HOST.description: Ollama host URL (required when using Ollama provider)

MILVUS_TOKEN.description: Your Zilliz Cloud API key or Milvus token for vector database access

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your Gemini API key (required when using Gemini provider)

MILVUS_ADDRESS.description: Your Zilliz Cloud public endpoint or Milvus address

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key (required when using OpenAI provider)

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: The embedding model to use. Default varies by provider (e.g., text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI, voyage-code-3 for VoyageAI, gemini-embedding-001 for Gemini, nomic-embed-text for Ollama)

GEMINI_BASE_URL.description: Custom API base URL for Gemini (for custom endpoints)

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Custom API base URL for OpenAI (for Azure OpenAI or other compatible services)

VOYAGEAI_API_KEY.description: Your VoyageAI API key (required when using VoyageAI provider)

CUSTOM_EXTENSIONS.description: Additional file extensions to include beyond defaults (e.g., .vue,.svelte,.astro,.twig)

EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: The embedding provider to use. Supported providers: OpenAI, VoyageAI, Gemini, Ollama

EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE.description: The embedding batch size to optimize the performance of the MCP server, depending on your embedding model throughput

CUSTOM_IGNORE_PATTERNS.description: Additional ignore patterns to exclude files/directories (e.g., temp/**,*.backup,private/**,uploads/**)

servers.name: Claude Context MCP

servers.description: Provides access to The Movie Database (TMDB) API for searching movies, retrieving movie details, cast information, and browsing current, upcoming, popular, and top-rated films, as well as searching for actors and directors.

TMDB_API_KEY.description: Your TMDB API key (can be obtained from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api)

servers.description: Enables comprehensive test management through SmartBear Zephyr Scale's REST API, supporting automated workflows for test cases, cycles, executions, folders, and linking tests to Jira issues through natural language.

ZEPHYR_API_TOKEN.description: Your Zephyr Scale API token (JWT token)

ZEPHYR_USE_EU_REGION.description: Set to true for EU region (default: false)
